title: Reddit Community & Marketing Specialist
description:
We are looking for a Reddit-savvy person to help us build an authentic presence across relevant Reddit communities.



We are a SaaS company in the online forms space, and we want to introduce forms.app to people who are already discussing topics related to forms, surveys, quizzes, polls, data collection, and similar tools.



This is *not a mass-posting or spam job*. We already have a curated list of relevant Reddit posts and discussions, so you will not be expected to spend your time researching subreddits or finding posting opportunities from scratch.



Instead, we will provide you with relevant opportunities, and your job will be to participate in these conversations naturally and appropriately.



What you'll do:



- Review the Reddit posts and discussions provided by our team

- Check the rules and guidelines of each subreddit before commenting

- Write short, clear, and natural comments that fit the conversation

- Recommend or mention forms.app when it is relevant and appropriate

- Follow each community's rules, tone, and guidelines

- Avoid repetitive, overly promotional, or spammy comments

- Share the direct link to each published comment with our team for tracking

- Keep track of your published comments in a shared spreadsheet



You do not need to write long or highly detailed comments. We value clear, useful, and natural responses over lengthy answers. The goal is to recommend forms.app in the right place and at the right time, while respecting each community's rules.



What we're looking for:



- Previous experience actively using Reddit

- A good understanding of Reddit communities, rules, and etiquette

- Strong written English

- The ability to write short, clear, and natural comments

- Good judgment when deciding how and when to mention a product

- The ability to follow subreddit-specific rules carefully

- Experience with SaaS, software, digital tools, or online communities is a plus



When applying, please share:



- Your Reddit profile(s)

- Examples of Reddit comments or posts you have written

- A short description of your Reddit experience

- Payment & Work Structure

- Type of Work: Part-time

- Hours: 10–15 hours per week

- Schedule: Flexible (there are no fixed working hours)

- Payment: $1 per approved comment

- Payment Schedule: Monthly



This is a flexible, part-time role. You can work according to your own schedule as long as you consistently publish relevant and high-quality comments.



We pay $1 for each approved comment that is relevant, original, clear, and compliant with the subreddit's rules.



Comments that are repetitive, irrelevant, overly promotional, removed by moderators, or posted solely to increase volume will not be counted.



After publishing a comment, you will share the direct link with our team. Approved comments will be tracked throughout the month, and the total payment will be calculated and sent at the end of each month.



Quality matters more than quantity. We are looking for someone who can promote forms.app naturally, at the right place and the right time, without violating community rules or making the conversation feel like an advertisement

Experience with EHR/EMR and practice management systems.

title: Digital Growth Operator for Australia's Best Hat Shop — Google, SEO, Social & Content | Long-Term
description:

Who I am — Google every word of this, it's all real



I'm Oska Truffaux. I've spent 20 years mastering one thing: Panama hats. I've personally fitted more than 150,000 of them, opened 32 stores across 29 countries — Hawaii, France, Japan — and been named International Milliner of the Year. Today I run Truffaux Hatmakers from a beautiful 1918 building in Olinda, in the forest hills outside Melbourne, Australia. People call it the best hat shop in Australia. Check 
, our Google reviews, TripAdvisor, @truffaux on Instagram. Five minutes of searching will show you this is a real business, a real founder, and a real reputation.



Now the exciting part: almost none of it is working online yet.



Most marketing jobs mean squeezing the last drops out of an over-marketed brand. This is the opposite. Twenty years of world-class reputation, products people cross the planet for, glowing reviews everywhere — and it is all deeply under-marketed. Every single improvement you make will show up in the numbers, fast. For the right marketer, that is the dream scenario. You won't be a cog in an agency. You'll be the person who did it.



The three missions



The Olinda shop — make Truffaux impossible to miss on Google when anyone in Victoria, or any tourist heading for the Dandenong Ranges, searches for hats or things to do. Maps, local SEO, reviews, tourism.

Truffaux worldwide — turn my 20 years of Panama hat knowledge into the internet's best hat content: articles, video, Reels, answers. Authority that converts to global online sales.

A brand-new premium cacao brand — I make what I honestly believe is the best-tasting cacao in the world. Nobody knows it yet. You'll help launch a category from zero: video, social, taste, story.



Hats, cacao, and — let's be honest — world domination.



What you'll actually do



Google Business Profile & Maps · local SEO · Google Search Console · keyword and competitor research · writing and optimising pages · Instagram &
 · Reels and short video (CapCut or similar) · Canva · scheduling and publishing · GA4 · AI-assisted research and content (we are an AI-native operation and you'll work alongside serious AI tools daily) · light Shopify/WordPress page edits · tracking what works · getting things DONE.



Who you are



2–5 years of real hands-on digital marketing. Excellent written English. Organised, curious, reliable — and above all resourceful. When you hit something you don't know, your instinct is "I'll figure it out," not "please send instructions." You'll work directly with me — no agency, no middle managers — plus an AI strategy layer that turns my ideas into clear, well-organised tasks, so you are never left guessing what to do. You need reliable internet and a computer that doesn't cry when you open thirty tabs.



What you get



A genuine long-term direct hire — I'm looking for someone to grow with these businesses for years, not a project gig

US$6–9/hour depending on capability (≈₱30,000–₱45,000/month at 20 hours/week to start)

20 hrs/week now → 30 → full-time as results come, with real raises tied to real results

Paid on time, every time · 13th month pay · Philippine holidays respected

Flexible hours — just a small daily overlap with Melbourne (we're only 2 hours ahead of you)

A short PAID trial test before hiring — I never ask for free work

Work that visibly matters: beautiful products, great stories, a founder who supplies endless raw material — and your name on the growth



To apply



Answer ALL of these. Applications that skip questions go straight in the bin.



The digital-growth project you're most proud of — what did YOU personally do, and what happened?

Links to 2–3 things you personally created or implemented.

Your experience with Google Business Profile, local SEO and Search Console.

Social accounts you've managed, what you achieved on them, and any short-form video you've made.

Which AI tools you use, and how.

Something you didn't know how to do — and how you figured it out.

Spend 10 minutes looking at Truffaux online. Tell me THREE things you would investigate first to bring more people into our Olinda shop.

Your current clients/jobs, your weekly availability, and the hourly rate you want.



Plus: a 1–2 minute Loom (or any video) introducing yourself. Unpolished is perfect — I want to hear how you think.



If you've read this far and felt something — apply. Let's make some noise.



— Oska

title: Virtual Assistant – Cleaner Recruiting & Staffing Coordinator
description:
Virtual Assistant – Cleaner Recruiting & Staffing Coordinator



**Full-Time | 40 Hours Per Week | Monday–Friday**

**Pay: $2.00 USD Per Hour**

**Work Schedule: 8:00 AM–5:00 PM MST**



We are looking for a reliable, organized, and highly motivated Virtual Assistant in the Philippines to manage our cleaner recruiting and hiring process.



This is **not just an administrative VA position**.



Your main responsibility will be making sure we have the right cleaners hired, scheduled, confirmed, and ready to work — with backup cleaners available when needed.



We are looking for someone who takes ownership of the hiring process from beginning to end.



YOUR MAIN RESPONSIBILITY



Your job is simple:



**Make sure our cleaning jobs are properly staffed with dependable people who actually show up.**



You will manage the entire recruiting process:



1. Post cleaning job advertisements.

2. Review new applicants.

3. Contact qualified applicants quickly.

4. Screen applicants by phone or video.

5. Conduct cleaner interviews.

6. Determine which applicants appear dependable and qualified.

7. Follow up with promising applicants.

8. Send hiring and onboarding paperwork.

9. Make sure paperwork is completed.

10. Coordinate the cleaner's work schedule and start date.

11. Confirm cleaners before their first scheduled shift.

12. Follow up to make sure they actually arrived and started.

13. Maintain backup candidates for every important position.

14. Immediately begin replacement recruiting when staffing coverage becomes weak.

15. Keep recruiting and staffing records organized and updated.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



We are not looking for someone who simply posts jobs and waits for applicants.



A high performer in this position:



* Responds to good applicants quickly.

* Follows up repeatedly when necessary.

* Can speak confidently with applicants.

* Knows how to identify dependable people.

* Notices red flags during interviews.

* Keeps candidates moving through the hiring process.

* Does not allow paperwork to sit unfinished.

* Confirms start dates.

* Makes sure new hires know where to go, when to arrive, and what is expected.

* Checks that the cleaner actually showed up.

* Maintains backup candidates instead of waiting for a staffing emergency.

* Immediately works on replacements when someone quits, stops responding, or becomes unreliable.



YOU MUST BE COMFORTABLE INTERVIEWING PEOPLE



A major part of this position will be talking directly with cleaning applicants.



You should be comfortable asking questions, listening carefully to answers, and deciding whether someone appears:



* Reliable

* Responsible

* Professional

* Able to follow instructions

* Available for the required schedule

* Able to reliably get to the work location

* Serious about actually starting the job



We do not want someone who simply checks boxes on an application.



We want someone who can develop good judgment about people.



DAILY RESPONSIBILITIES



During your workday you may:



* Post and refresh recruiting advertisements.

* Review incoming applications.

* Call, text, or
 applicants.

* Conduct applicant screening calls.

* Schedule interviews.

* Conduct interviews.

* Follow up with applicants who do not immediately respond.

* Select the strongest candidates.

* Send hiring documents.

* Track incomplete paperwork.

* Coordinate start dates.

* Send schedule and first-day instructions.

* Confirm upcoming new hires.

* Verify successful first-day starts.

* Build lists of backup cleaners.

* Recruit replacements when necessary.

* Update recruiting and staffing trackers.

* Communicate staffing problems to management immediately.



THE JOB DOES NOT END WHEN SOMEONE SAYS "YES"



This is extremely important.



Hiring someone is not successful until:



**They complete the required paperwork, understand the assignment, confirm the schedule, arrive for work, and successfully begin the job.**



You will be expected to follow each person through that entire process.



BACKUP STAFFING



We do not want to discover that we need another cleaner after someone fails to show up.



Part of your responsibility is maintaining backup coverage.



For important positions, you should know:



* Who the primary cleaner is.

* Whether they have confirmed.

* Who the backup candidate is.

* Which additional applicants could be contacted quickly if needed.



You should always be thinking ahead.



QUALIFICATIONS



You may be a good fit if you:



* Speak and write English well.

* Are comfortable speaking with applicants on the phone or video.

* Have strong follow-up skills.

* Are organized.

* Work quickly.

* Can manage many applicants at the same time.

* Are comfortable making decisions.

* Pay attention to details.

* Do not need someone constantly reminding you what to do.

* Take responsibility for getting an outcome.

* Can professionally represent a U.S. company.



Recruiting, HR, staffing, call center, appointment-setting, or hiring experience is helpful but not required if you are a strong communicator and fast learner.



## WORK SCHEDULE



**Monday–Friday**

**8:00 AM–5:00 PM Mountain Standard Time**

**40 hours per week**



You must be consistently available during these hours.



COMPENSATION



**$2.00 USD per hour**



This is a full-time long-term position for the right person.



HOW TO APPLY



Please include the following in your application:



1. Tell us about any recruiting, interviewing, hiring, staffing, customer service, or phone experience you have.

2. Tell us how comfortable you are interviewing applicants by phone.

3. Explain what you would do if a cleaner was scheduled to start tomorrow morning but stopped responding today.

4. Explain how you would make sure we always have backup cleaners available.

5. Send a short voice recording introducing yourself and explaining why you believe you would be good at this position.



**Important:** Start your application with the words:



**“I CAN OWN THE HIRING PROCESS.”**



Applications that do not follow this instruction may not be reviewed.

title: Meta Ads Manager - Help Us Grow Sydney Physio Group
description:
Do you like the kind of work where you can actually see the results of what you do? Where a good ad doesn't just get clicks, it turns into a real person booking an appointment because they felt like they were in the right place?



We're looking for someone to run Meta Ads across our three clinics in Sydney Australia, and take real ownership of how people find us and book in.



You'll be across the whole funnel: campaigns, leads, and making sure people actually convert into booked appointments, not just clicks that go nowhere.



Part Time remote role Salary: $600 AUD/month, 20 hours per week. Full time growth potential for the right candidate getting great results!



What you'll be responsible for



- Managing and optimising Meta Ads campaigns across all three clinics, end to end

- Building, refining, and managing audiences - custom audiences, lookalikes, exclusions, and keeping an eye on overlap so campaigns aren't competing against each other

- Setting up and running retargeting campaigns for people who've visited our site or interacted with our content, choosing the right objective and performance goal so we're optimising for bookings, not just reach

- Working with our content creator to brief and request alternative creative to test - you won't need to produce the creative yourself, but you'll know what to ask for and why

- Monitoring lead flow and campaign performance, and tracking cost per lead against actual bookings

- Managing lead handoff into our systems and running reactivation campaigns for people who haven't booked yet

- Proactively spotting opportunities - new audiences worth testing, creative angles, or campaign structures that could perform better - rather than just running what you're told

- Reporting weekly on what's working, what isn't, and why

- Taking ownership of the whole thing - this is a "figure it out and tell me what happened" role, not a "wait for instructions" one. We need someone with initiative and a growth mindset.

- Keeping an eye on our organic Meta content too — what's landing, what isn't, and feeding that back into paid strategy (and vice versa)



The type of person we're looking for



You're someone who:



- Understands Meta's ad platform properly — not just boosting posts, but setting objectives, reading a pixel, and knowing why a campaign is or isn't performing

- Is genuinely up to date with how Meta Ads Manager works day to day, and can explain what's happening in plain terms, because we won't be checking your setup ourselves — we're trusting you to know the platform better than we do

- Writes well, and can pick up a brand voice instead of falling back on generic ad copy

- Pays attention to the numbers, but also to the person on the other end of the ad

- Takes ownership of results and doesn't need to be chased

- Is comfortable owning the whole account, not just executing tasks — you'll be the one d
 what to test next and asking our content creator for what you need

- Is comfortable working with a healthcare brand, where some of the usual targeting and retargeting rules work differently to ecommerce



Experience we're looking for



- Experience managing Meta Ads campaigns, ideally for a local or service-based business

- Understanding of lead generation funnels and retargeting setup

- Experience with CRM platforms (we use GoHighLevel)

- Bonus: experience with health, allied health, or another industry with advertising restrictions



About us



Sydney Physio Group runs three clinics — Freshwater, North Ryde, and Waverton — each with its own character, but all built around the same idea: people should feel like they're in the right place. We're not chasing the biggest or loudest presence. We'd rather do three clinics really well than ten averagely.



How to apply



Do not send us a DM. Please respond here.



Start your application with why you are interested in this role.



Please also include:

- Your resume

- A short written response (a paragraph or two is plenty) after looking at our 

1. Pick one organic post you'd scale with paid Meta ads — which one, and why that one specifically?

2. How would you approach scaling it? (audience, objective, anything you'd change or test before putting budget behind it)

3. What's one question you'd want answered before touching anything?



We're not looking for polish here — we're looking for whether you've actually looked at us, how you think about scaling organic into paid, and whether that thinking is sound. Applications that skip this or send something generic won't move forward.



Looking forward to hearing from you!

Sarah

We are a luxury real estate media company, photographing high end luxury homes for our clients. We are looking to bring on and train one photo editor to join our team long term. title: Long-Form YouTube Video Editor – Fishing & Storytelling Content
description:
I am seeking a reliable and experienced long-form YouTube video editor to work with me on my fishing channel, Stillwater Fishing.



This role is specifically for my talking, story-driven fishing videos. I am looking for an editor who can do more than simply cut footage together. The ideal candidate should understand how to use pacing, music, sound design, camera selection, and visual techniques to guide the viewer through the emotional progression of a video.



I am also an experienced editor, so I have a clear creative direction for my content and will be actively involved in the editing process.



Content Style



My videos typically include a combination of:



* DJI action-camera footage

* Insta360 / 360-degree footage

* Multiple camera angles

* Dialogue and direct-to-camera moments

* Fishing sequences

* Humorous moments

* High-energy moments such as hooksets and fish fights

* Relaxed sections focused on the overall fishing experience



Raw footage can be approximately 2 hours or more, with final videos typically ranging from 10–20 minutes.



One of the most important parts of my editing style is the intentional use of different camera perspectives.



For example, when I am speaking directly to the audience, the front-facing DJI footage is often the most appropriate choice. When I am casting, working a lure, moving around, fighting a fish, or demonstrating how I am fishing, the 360 footage is often used to create more dynamic and visually engaging sequences.



Experience working with 360-degree footage is strongly preferred.



Strong Storytelling Ability



The most important creative requirement for this position is an understanding of storytelling and emotional pacing.



I want the editing to support what is happening emotionally in each moment of the video.



If a scene is lighthearted or humorous, the music, timing, sound effects, zooms, and cuts should support that tone.



If I begin noticing signs that a fish may be biting, the edit should gradually build anticipation. This may involve:



* A subtle change in music

* A riser or tension-building sound effect

* More deliberate cuts

* A gradual crop or zoom

* A change in camera angle

* Allowing certain moments to breathe before the payoff



If I then set the hook and a fish is on, the edit should make that moment feel significant. Music, pacing, camera changes, and sound design can all be used to increase the energy of the scene.



Once that moment is over and the video returns to a more relaxed fishing sequence, the edit should also know how to bring the viewer back into a calmer pace.



The editor should be able to guide the viewer naturally through transitions such as:



Relaxed → Humorous → Curious → Tense → Exciting → Payoff → Relaxed



I will provide examples from my own YouTube videos so the selected editor can clearly understand the pacing, style, and overall feeling I am trying to achieve.



Adobe Premiere Pro Is Required



Applicants must edit in Adobe Premiere Pro.



Please do not apply if your primary workflow is based entirely in CapCut or another editing platform.



Because I also edit my own content, there may be times when I need access to the Premiere Pro project file so I can make small editorial changes, review the timeline, or continue working on the project myself.



Our editing workflows must therefore be compatible.



Reliable Internet Connection Is Required



This is a very important requirement.



My projects involve large 4K video files and 360-degree footage, which means editors must regularly download and upload large amounts of data.



Applicants must have a stable and reliable internet connection capable of handling large file transfers.



Repeated issues with downloading footage, uploading completed projects, or meeting deadlines due to internet limitations will make it difficult to maintain the workflow required for this position.



Communication Expectations



Strong and consistent communication is extremely important to me.



I am not looking for an editor who receives a project, works independently for several days without communication, and only sends the final version once the entire edit is complete.



I prefer a collaborative editing process.



Because I have editing experience myself, I can provide detailed creative direction and feedback throughout the project. I would like the editor to provide regular progress updates, share sections of the video when appropriate, and ask questions whenever there is uncertainty about a creative decision.



This allows me to provide feedback early in the process rather than waiting until the entire video is completed and potentially requesting significant revisions.



I am happy to coach and guide the right editor as they become more familiar with my editing style.



The ideal working relationship will involve consistent communication, collaboration, and creative feedback throughout the editing process.



Ideal Candidate



The ideal editor should:



* Edit professionally in Adobe Premiere Pro

* Have a stable and reliable internet connection

* Communicate consistently and proactively

* Be comfortable receiving detailed creative feedback

* Be able to work with large 4K video files

* Be comfortable working with Insta360 / 360-degree footage

* Understand long-form YouTube storytelling

* Understand pacing and viewer retention

* Know how to use music intentionally to support the emotion of a scene

* Understand sound design, including risers, impacts, transitions, and subtle sound effects

* Know when memes or humorous editing elements enhance a scene without overusing them

* Understand how to use zooms, crops, reframing, and camera positioning intentionally

* Recognize when a scene should feel relaxed, humorous, tense, exciting, or emotional

* Be capable of adapting to an established editing style

* Be dependable and capable of meeting agreed-upon deadlines



Workload and Compensation



I am currently looking for approximately 2–4 videos per month.



Compensation will generally range from $30–$75 USD per completed video, depending on experience, editing quality, project complexity, and the amount of work required.



There is potential for consistent long-term work for the right editor.



Paid Trial Edit



Shortlisted applicants will be asked to complete a paid $10 trial edit using footage from one of my actual fishing videos.



The purpose of the trial is to evaluate:



* Storytelling ability

* Music selection

* Sound design

* Pacing

* Camera selection

* Use of 360 footage

* Ability to follow creative direction



How to Apply



Please begin your application with the word BASS so I know you have read the full job description.



Please include:



1. A brief introduction about yourself and your editing experience.

2. Your experience editing long-form YouTube content.

3. Confirmation that you edit using Adobe Premiere Pro.

4. Your experience working with Insta360 or other 360-degree footage, if applicable.

5. Links to 2–3 of your strongest long-form editing examples that demonstrate storytelling ability.

6. A brief description of your internet connection and your ability to reliably download and upload large video files.

7. Your response to the following editing scenario:



A fishing sequence begins calmly while I am speaking to the camera. I suddenly feel several small taps on my lure, become quiet, focus on what I am feeling, and say, “I think he is still there.” A few seconds later, I set the hook and a large fish is on.



Please briefly explain how you would approach this sequence using music, sound design, pacing, camera angles, and editing techniques to move the viewer from a relaxed moment into tension and ultimately into the payoff of the hookset.



There is no single correct answer. I am interested in understanding how you think creatively as an editor.



I am looking for someone who can become a reliable long-term part of the channel and who is interested in developing a strong working relationship over time.



If you are creative, dependable, communicative, and confident that you can match an established editing style, I would be interested in reviewing your application.

title: Finance Manager
description:
Are you the person who always knows exactly where the money is?



Not because someone asked. Because you can't stand not knowing.



We're a US-based agency looking for a part-time Finance Manager to own our money in and money out. This is about 20 hours a month — roughly 5 hours a week. 



Who we are



Formwork is a US agency that runs sales, marketing, and software delivery for construction companies. About ten active clients, a distributed team of contractors, and an internal financial platform we built ourselves.



Why this role is different from most bookkeeping jobs:



Most part-time finance roles are data entry with a nicer title. This one isn't, for one specific reason: the analysis is already automated.



We built an internal financial system that generates the P&L, runs the profitability analysis, produces the AR aging with recommended escalation actions, audits time tracking, and projects labor cost to month-end. You don't build reports. You run the system, judge what it tells you, act on it, and bring the exceptions to the executives.



That's what makes 20 hours a month realistic for a scope this wide. And it's why we can hire someone genuinely senior for part-time hours instead of a full-time junior who'd spend the whole month in spreadsheets.



Why you'll want this role



You report directly to the executives. No middle layer, no committee. You bring the exceptions and the decisions; they handle the calls only you two should make.



Real ownership, not just processing. You'll host our forecasting calls with department heads, set target margins per client service, and enforce budgets. That's a finance manager's job, not a bookkeeper's.



Paid well because we want this to be a long-term relationship, not a stopgap.



It stacks. Five hours a week fits alongside your other clients. We're not asking for exclusivity.



The systems and SOPs already exist. You'll be productive in weeks, not months.



What you'll actually be doing



Accounts Payable



Prepare the contractor payment runs and queue them for approval

Collect end-of-week timesheet approvals from the team, and chase the people who forget

Notify staff of their expected payment dates

Log every AP event on the cashflow calendar



Accounts Receivable



Create and send client invoices on the monthly schedule

Follow up on outstanding invoices and actually collect them

Log every AR event on the cashflow calendar



Forecasting



Host the labor forecast call with department heads twice a month, then update the system

Host the hardware and software forecast call once a month, then update the system

Keep the cashflow calendar current as new information arrives

Update client budgets against the month's scope of work



General Finance



Track subscription changes as they happen

Triage the financials page and QuickBooks Online

Make sure client budgets are actually being followed, and flag overruns before they land

Set the target margin for each client service each month

Work with our outside tax team



You'll crush this role if you...



Are a licensed CPA, or a senior bookkeeper with 5+ years running a full AP and AR cycle



Know QuickBooks Online



Have worked with multiple clients or entities at once (agency, professional services, or outsourced accounting)



Chase things without being asked, because nobody here is going to remind you



Can hold a professional call in English — you'll host recurring calls with department heads and sometimes speak with clients about invoices



Are comfortable saying "that number looks wrong to me" to the person who signs your invoice



Would instinctively verify if a vendor
ed you saying their bank details changed



Actually want part-time work as part of how you've built your career, not as a placeholder until something full-time comes along



Nice to have, not required: experience with a US-based company, familiarity with Wise or other international payment platforms, exposure to construction or professional services accounting.



This role is not for you if...



You're looking for full-time hours (we're genuinely only offering ~20/month)



You want to strictly record history and never look forward — half this job is forecasting



You avoid conflict, because chasing overdue clients and unresponsive department heads is the job



You need to be told what to do each week



Your spoken English isn't strong enough for a live call with US colleagues



Role details



Type: Part-time independent contractor



Hours: ~20 hours per month (about 5 hrs/week)



Compensation: $600 - $900 USD per month, paid monthly via Wise



Location: Fully remote



Schedule: Flexible, but you must be reachable during a 2-hour daily window overlapping US Central mornings, and available for scheduled forecast calls



Reports to: Managing Partner



Start: As soon as we find the right person



Ramp: Expect 30-35 hours in each of your first two months while you learn the system. Paid accordingly.



Probation: 90 days, with structured check-ins at Day 30, 60, and 90



How to apply



Apply here: 



The form takes about 10 minutes and includes one short video — a single 2-3 minute recording answering two questions. 



Applications without the video will not be reviewed — no exceptions, and a generic pre-recorded intro doesn't count.



Please don't send a resume by
 or reply here. The form is the only path.



We review applications within 48 hours and respond to strong ones within 24.

Take ownership of every assigned lead.

Care about customer experience and the quality of appointments booked.

Please Do Not Apply If

You are uncomfortable with follow-ups, objections or performance targets.

You cannot provide clear information about your previous results.

Speed of response to new leads.

Customer contact rate.

Number of genuinely qualified appointments booked.

Appointment attendance rate.

Accuracy and completeness of CRM notes.

Number of appointments progressing to quotations and sales.

Customer feedback and call quality.

Consistency, reliability and follow-up discipline.

What We Provide

Warm inbound leads generated through our marketing campaigns.

An established Australian brand with a Perth showroom and installation team.

Training on our products, pricing, qualification criteria and processes.

Approved call guides and objection-handling support.

GoHighLevel CRM access and structured workflows.

Competitive base salary based on verified experience.

Performance incentives linked to qualified appointments that attend and completed sales.

Stable, long-term employment.

Opportunities to progress into a Senior Appointment Setter, Sales Consultant or Team Leader position.

How to Apply



Please submit your updated CV and answer every question below:



How many years have you worked in appointment setting or telesales?

Which Australian companies or campaigns have you worked with?

Which products or services were you promoting?

Were the leads inbound, warm outbound or cold?

Approximately how many calls did you make each day?

Which Australian states did you contact?

Your experience speaking with Australian customers.

Your experience booking appointments.

How you would respond if a customer said: “I am only comparing prices. Just send me the cheapest option.”

title: ADS MANAGER
description:
Paid Ads Manager



We are looking for an experienced Paid Ads Manager to join our creative agency, managing advertising campaigns across a varied portfolio of clients in hospitality, events, wellness, professional services and other industries.



This role requires someone who can plan, build, monitor and improve campaigns while communicating results clearly. You should be comfortable managing multiple accounts, working to quick deadlines and adapting campaigns as client priorities, budgets and creative assets change.



Key Responsibilities

Plan, build and manage paid advertising campaigns across Meta Ads and Google Ads.

Develop campaign strategies based on each client’s goals, audience and available budget.

Manage campaigns focused on lead generation, bookings, sales, website traffic, awareness and event promotion.

Build suitable campaign, ad-set and audience structures.

Set up prospecting, retargeting and remarketing campaigns.

Complete audience, keyword and competitor research.

Work with the creative team to identify effective messaging, formats and advertising assets.

Write and test clear, persuasive ad copy.

Monitor campaign performance, budgets and pacing.

Test different creative assets, audiences, placements and campaign objectives.

Optimise campaigns based on reliable performance data.

Set up and review tracking through Meta Pixel, Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics and platform conversion tools.

Troubleshoot tracking, attribution, account-access and campaign-delivery issues.

Produce clear reports that explain performance, insights and recommended next steps.

Manage multiple advertising accounts within a fast-moving agency environment.

Respond professionally to feedback and adjust campaigns as client requirements develop.

Essential Requirements

Minimum of two years’ professional paid advertising experience.

Intermediate to advanced knowledge of Meta Ads Manager.

Strong working knowledge of Google Ads.

Experience managing campaigns across multiple client accounts.

Understanding of campaign objectives, audience targeting, bidding, budgets and attribution.

Experience with lead-generation, conversion, booking and ecommerce campaigns.

Good knowledge of Meta Pixel, Google Analytics 4 and Google Tag Manager.

Ability to evaluate key metrics such as CPM, CTR, CPC, CPA, ROAS and conversion rate.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Excellent attention to detail when building, monitoring and reporting on campaigns.

Very high standard of written and spoken English.

Ability to write clear and effective advertising copy.

Strong communication skills and a professional approach to client feedback.

Ability to manage multiple deadlines, budgets and campaigns simultaneously.

Reliable access to high-speed internet and a suitable remote working environment.

The Ideal Candidate



You are commercially aware, organised and comfortable taking responsibility for advertising performance. You can move beyond simply launching campaigns and explain what is working, what is not working and what should happen next.



You understand the relationship between creative quality, audience targeting, campaign structure and the customer journey. You are confident making decisions based on data while recognising when a campaign needs stronger creative, a better offer or an improved landing page.



You communicate clearly, manage budgets carefully and keep accounts structured so campaign activity can be easily reviewed by the wider team.



Application



Please include:



A short introduction outlining your paid advertising experience.

Examples of campaigns or accounts you have managed.

Relevant results, including budget ranges and key performance improvements.

Details of your experience with Meta Ads and Google Ads.

Examples of your tracking and analytics experience.

Any relevant certifications.

Your general availability and typical reporting process.

title: Audience & Market Development Coordinator
description:
We are looking for an organized, curious, and dependable Audience & Market Development Coordinator to help manage audience engagement and market-development activities across several of our online brands.



This is not primarily a content-creation position.



Your role will focus on social media account management, audience engagement, prospect research, relationship development, and capturing useful market intelligence.



Primary Responsibilities



You will support the following brands:



Systemized Freedom

• Manage audience engagement on Instagram.

• Find and interact with relevant accounts and conversations.

• Help us better understand the professionals and entrepreneurs within the brand’s target audience.



Aerospace Quality Academy

• Manage audience engagement on Instagram.

• Engage with Aerospace Quality, engineering, manufacturing, and related professional communities.

• Capture recurring questions, problems, terminology, and audience interests.



BookedJobs

• Manage audience engagement on Instagram.

• Research and connect with relevant business owners, operators, and industry professionals.

Audience Intelligence

Experience with social-media engagement, LinkedIn prospecting, market research, lead generation, CRM systems, or business development is helpful but not required.

Schedule

How to Apply

Instead, complete Assessment 1 using the application link below:



Assessment 1:

Candidates who meet our requirements will be contacted directly regarding the next step in the hiring process.

We are looking for a highly organized, creative, dependable, and proactive Remote Marketing & Client Experience Coordinator to help us grow our online presence, create engaging content, manage our social media platforms, support our customers, and keep our marketing systems organized.



This is not a traditional administrative VA position. We are looking for someone who can think like a marketer, communicate like a receptionist, create like a content creator, and operate independently like a trusted team member.

Friendly and professional



Creative and comfortable creating social media content



Highly organized



Reliable and punctual

, TikTok, and Google Business

Comfortable working U.S. business hours

REQUIRED

Strong English communication skills

title: Legal & Medical Case Coordination Virtual Assistant
description:
Position Description



(Virtual) Legal & Medical Administrative Assistant



Location: Remote (Philippines)



Employment Type: Ongoing Contract (Part-Time, with opportunity to increase hours)



Hours: Approximately 40 hours per week initially



Time Zone: Australian Eastern Standard Time (preferred)



About the Role



We are seeking a highly organised, proactive and detail-oriented Legal & Medical Administrative Assistant to provide comprehensive administrative, case coordination and document preparation support across complex client matters.

This is not a traditional virtual assistant role. You will become the central point of coordination for matters involving healthcare providers, legal representatives, government agencies, insurers and community organisations. You will manage day-to-day administration, coordinate stakeholders, prepare professional documentation, track deadlines and ensure matters progress efficiently.



A key component of this role involves supporting clients through legal and administrative appeal processes. You will assist in preparing appeal documentation, organising supporting evidence, maintaining comprehensive case files and ensuring submissions are complete, accurate and lodged within required timeframes. While you will assist with drafting and document preparation, all final legal and professional decisions will remain with the supervising professional.

The successful candidate will be capable of working independently, anticipating needs, solving problems proactively and producing work of a consistently high professional standard.



Resilience & Professional Boundaries



This role involves supporting clients who may experience complex mental health conditions, including trauma-related presentations. At times, interactions may involve heightened emotions, frustration or challenging communication.



The successful candidate will demonstrate:



- Emotional resilience and the ability to remain calm and professional under pressure.

- Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate respectfully and effectively in challenging situations.

- The confidence to maintain professional boundaries while providing compassionate, client-centred support.

- Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to de-escalate conversations through clear, calm and respectful communication.

- The ability to remain organised and focused when managing sensitive or high-pressure matters.

- A commitment to treating all clients with dignity, empathy and professionalism, while recognising when to seek guidance or escalate concerns appropriately.

- Experience working with clients experiencing trauma, PTSD, mental health conditions, or within healthcare, legal, veterans' services, disability, or community services will be highly regarded.



Key Responsibilities



Executive & Administrative Support



- Manage calendars, appointments and scheduling.

- Coordinate meetings with clients, healthcare providers, legal representatives and external stakeholders.

- Manage
 correspondence and inbox organisation where delegated.

- Prepare agendas, meeting minutes and action registers.

- Maintain digital filing systems and ensure document version control.

- Prepare and submit administrative forms and applications.

- Develop and improve administrative systems and workflows.

- Assist with general business administration as required.



Case Coordination



- Coordinate complex client matters involving multiple stakeholders.

- Liaise with healthcare professionals, allied health providers, government departments, insurers and legal representatives.

- Monitor outstanding reports, referrals and assessments.

- Follow up practitioners regarding outstanding documentation.

- Maintain detailed case timelines and evidence registers.

- Track review dates, tribunal deadlines and key milestones.

- Identify risks, delays and outstanding actions requiring escalation.

- Ensure all case documentation remains organised, current and audit-ready.



Legal Appeals & Case Support



- Assist in preparing legal and administrative appeal documentation.

- Compile, organise and index supporting evidence for appeals and reviews.

- Prepare document bundles and supporting schedules for submission.

- Maintain detailed chronologies and timelines of key events.

- Monitor appeal deadlines and ensure all documentation is prepared on time.

- Liaise with client, legal representatives and practitioners to obtain supporting documentation.

- Assist in drafting correspondence relating to appeal matters.

- Prepare case summaries and briefing documents for review.

- Maintain confidential records relating to legal and administrative proceedings.



Document Preparation & Professional Writing



- Prepare first drafts of professional reports, submissions and correspondence.

- Draft letters to healthcare providers, government departments, insurers and legal representatives.

- Compile evidence into structured reports and case summaries.

- Develop chronological timelines of significant events.

- Prepare executive summaries and briefing documents.

- Edit, proofread and professionally format documentation.

- Convert meeting notes, voice recordings and handwritten notes into polished documents.

- Conduct research to support document preparation where required.

- Prepare presentation materials and information packs.



Research & Information Gathering (Discovery)



- Conduct research into legislation, policies, government programs and healthcare systems (across Australia, and Philippines).

- Source relevant evidence to support client matters.

- Review and summarise medical reports and supporting documentation.

- Prepare research summaries and briefing papers.

- Monitor changes to relevant legislation, funding pathways and administrative processes.



Project & Workflow Management



- Develop and maintain project plans and task trackers.

- Monitor workload priorities and upcoming deadlines.

- Coordinate multiple concurrent matters.

- Maintain action registers and ensure timely follow-up.

- Recommend improvements to systems and processes.

- Assist in implementing efficient workflows across the business.



Document & Records Management



- Organise electronic files and maintain structured document libraries.

- Ensure confidentiality and secure handling of sensitive information.

- Maintain naming conventions and document control processes.

- Prepare document bundles for meetings, submissions and reviews.

- Archive completed matters in accordance with organisational procedures.



Essential Skills & Experience



Applicants should possess:



- Minimum three years' experience in one or more of the following:

- Legal Assistant

- Medical Administration

- Administrative Assistant

- Case Management

- Paralegal

- Virtual Assistant

- Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills.

- Outstanding attention to detail.

- Strong organisational and time-management skills.

- Ability to manage multiple complex matters simultaneously.

- Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

- Excellent problem-solving skills.

- High level of professionalism and discretion.

- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office and Google Workspace.

- Experience with cloud-based document management systems.

- Knowledge of legal governance and policy within Australia and the Philippines.

- Demonstrated emotional resilience and the ability to communicate professionally and effectively in emotionally demanding or high-pressure environments.

- Applicants must be current residents of the Philippines and available to work during Australian business (AEST) hours.



Highly Desirable



- Preference will be given to candidates with experience in:

- Australian legal administration.

- Australian healthcare administration.

- Philippine legal administration.

- Appeals, tribunal or litigation support.

- Government agency correspondence.

- DVA, NDIS or workers' compensation administration.

- Medical terminology.

- Project coordination.

- Productivity software.



Personal Attributes



- The successful candidate will be:

- Exceptionally organised.

- Proactive rather than reactive.

- Calm under pressure.

- Able to think critically and solve problems independently.

- Highly reliable and accountable.

- Professionally presented in written communication.

- Comfortable managing confidential and sensitive information.

- Resourceful and adaptable.

- Committed to producing work of a consistently high standard.



Technology Requirements



Applicants should have:



- Reliable high-speed internet.

- Dual-monitor workstation (preferred).

- Modern computer capable of running Microsoft Office and cloud-based software.

- Professional home office environment suitable for confidential work.



Performance Expectations



Within the first three months, the successful candidate should be able to:



- Independently manage day-to-day administration.

- Coordinate appointments and stakeholder communications efficiently.

- Maintain accurate case files, timelines and evidence registers.

- Produce high-quality drafts of reports, submissions and correspondence requiring minimal editing.

- Assist in preparing organised and complete legal and administrative appeal documentation.

- Ensure no deadlines are missed through proactive task management.

- Improve administrative systems and workflow efficiency.

- Become the primary administrative point of contact for assigned matters.



Remuneration



- Competitive remuneration will be offered based on experience, qualifications and demonstrated capability.



How to Apply



Please submit:



- Your current resume.

- A cover letter outlining your relevant experience.

- Your expected hourly rate AU.

- Your weekly daily availability.

- Your notice period (if applicable).

Only applicants with excellent written English, exceptional organisational skills and relevant legal, medical or administrative experience will be shortlisted. Successful candidates will also be required to do a National Police Check.

title: Virtual Assistant / Customer Service & Scheduling Coordinator – Cleaning Company
description:
We are an established window cleaning and exterior cleaning company based in Southern California looking for a **highly reliable, experienced Virtual Assistant** to help manage our day-to-day customer communication, scheduling, quoting, and administrative operations.



This is not just a basic data-entry VA position. We are looking for someone who can become a dependable part of our team and help keep the business organized and running smoothly.



## What You'll Be Doing



* Answer incoming customer phone calls

* Respond to missed calls, texts,
s, and website inquiries

* Provide customers with pricing and estimates using our established pricing system

* Schedule and reschedule cleaning appointments

* Manage our calendar and technician schedules

* Follow up with customers and leads

* Contact previous customers for repeat service

* Confirm upcoming appointments

* Communicate schedule changes with customers and technicians

* Enter and update customer information in our CRM

* Help resolve basic customer service issues

* Perform general administrative tasks

* Communicate regularly with the owner and other team members through Slack/WhatsApp



We currently use **Housecall Pro**, so previous experience with Housecall Pro or another home-service CRM such as Jobber, ServiceTitan, or similar software is strongly preferred.



## Cleaning / Home Service Experience Preferred



We strongly prefer someone who has previously worked remotely for a:



* Window cleaning company

* House cleaning company

* Pressure washing company

* Landscaping company

* Plumbing, HVAC, electrical, roofing, pest control, or other home-service business



Experience **scheduling technicians or cleaning crews and communicating directly with customers** is especially valuable.



## Spoken English Requirement



Because you will regularly speak with customers in the United States, **excellent spoken English is required**.



We are specifically looking for someone with:



* Fluent conversational English

* Clear pronunciation

* Strong listening skills

* Natural, friendly communication

* A **neutral, Western, or American-sounding English accent**

* Confidence speaking with American customers over the phone



You must be comfortable answering calls, giving estimates, explaining services, and scheduling appointments without relying on scripts for every conversation.



**Applicants will be asked to submit a short voice recording as part of the application process.**



## Reliability Is Extremely Important



This is one of the most important requirements for this position.



We need someone who can consistently show up for their scheduled shift and who takes attendance and communication seriously.



You should have:



* A dependable computer

* Reliable high-speed internet

* Backup internet such as mobile data or a secondary connection

* A charged phone and reliable method of communication

* A backup plan for internet or power outages whenever reasonably possible

* A quiet professional environment for customer phone calls



Emergencies happen, and we understand that. However, **unexplained absences, repeatedly oversleeping, disappearing during scheduled work hours, or failing to communicate when you cannot work will not be acceptable.**



If something prevents you from working, we expect you to communicate with us as soon as reasonably possible.



## The Person We're Looking For



You would probably be a great fit if you are:



* Extremely dependable

* Organized

* Proactive

* Friendly and personable

* Comfortable talking to customers

* Good at multitasking

* Able to make decisions without constantly asking for instructions

* Detail-oriented

* Comfortable working independently

* Good at managing schedules and solving scheduling conflicts

* Able to stay calm when customers are frustrated or plans suddenly change



We especially value someone who thinks:



**"How can I solve this?"**



rather than waiting for the owner to tell them what to do every step of the way.



## Preferred Experience



Strong candidates will ideally have:



* 2+ years of Virtual Assistant or customer service experience

* Experience answering U.S. customer phone calls

* Experience scheduling employees, technicians, or cleaning crews

* Previous cleaning or home-service industry experience

* CRM experience

* Housecall Pro experience

* Sales or lead-follow-up experience

* Experience working remotely with a U.S.-based small business



## Schedule



This position will work during **U.S. Pacific Time business hours**.



Applicants must be comfortable consistently working the agreed-upon schedule.



## To Apply



Please include the following:



1. A short introduction about yourself and your work experience.

2. Describe any experience you have working for a cleaning or home-service company.

3. Describe your experience scheduling technicians, cleaners, or appointments.

4. Tell us which CRM or scheduling systems you have used.

5. Send a **30–60 second voice recording introducing yourself and describing your previous job experience.**

6. Describe your primary internet connection and backup internet connection.

7. Explain what you would do if your electricity or internet went out during your scheduled shift.

8. Tell us about your computer/laptop specifications.

9. Tell us what hours you are available to work in Pacific Time.

10. Answer this scenario:



**You go on your lunch break at 12:00 PM and unexpectedly become unable to return to work. What would you do?**



Please begin your application with the words **"Reliable VA"** so we know you carefully read the entire job posting.

title: Mid to Senior Level Accountant
description:
Mid to Senior Level Accountant



Location: Remote

Employment Type: Full-time

Salary: depending on experience and skill set



About Us



We are a fast-growing accounting firm that partners with ambitious business owners to provide hands-on accounting support, accurate financial reporting, and practical business insights.



Our team is dynamic, collaborative, and committed to delivering high-quality accounting services across a diverse portfolio of Australian businesses and industries.



As we continue to grow, we are looking for a highly capable Mid to Senior Level Accountant who can take ownership of client accounts, work independently, and provide reliable financial support and insights to business owners.



This role is ideal for an experienced accountant who is confident working with Australian businesses, has strong Xero expertise, understands BAS and compliance requirements, and can move beyond transaction processing to become a trusted accounting partner to clients.



The Role



As a Mid to Senior Level Accountant, you will be responsible for managing the accounting function for an assigned portfolio of clients.



You will oversee day-to-day accounting activities, month-end processes, compliance requirements, financial reporting, and client communication while identifying opportunities to improve processes and provide greater value to clients.



You will work closely with the founder and senior team members and will be expected to demonstrate a high level of accuracy, accountability, initiative, and professional judgement.



Key ResponsibilitiesFinancial Accounting & Reporting



Manage end-to-end accounting functions for an assigned portfolio of clients.

Perform and review bank, credit card, cash, payroll, and balance sheet reconciliations.

Prepare and review monthly financial statements and management reports.

Complete month-end and year-end accounting procedures.

Prepare and post journals, accruals, prepayments, depreciation, and other adjusting entries.

Analyse financial results, variances, trends, and key performance indicators.

Identify unusual transactions, discrepancies, and potential financial risks.

Ensure financial records are complete, accurate, and maintained in accordance with applicable accounting standards and client requirements.

Accounts Payable & Accounts Receivable



Manage and oversee accounts payable and accounts receivable processes.

Review and approve invoice processing and coding where required.

Monitor outstanding receivables and conduct debtor follow-ups.

Assist clients with cash-flow management and payment scheduling.

Investigate and resolve discrepancies relating to invoices, payments, and customer/supplier accounts.

Improve processes to ensure timely and accurate transaction processing.

Australian Tax & Compliance



Prepare and review Business Activity Statements (BAS).

Ensure GST transactions are correctly recorded and reconciled.

Prepare relevant compliance reports and supporting schedules.

Assist with tax preparation and year-end requirements as required.

Maintain accurate records and documentation to support compliance and audit requirements.

Liaise with clients and relevant stakeholders regarding accounting and compliance matters.

Client Management & Advisory



Manage and maintain strong relationships with an assigned portfolio of clients.

Act as a trusted point of contact for accounting and financial queries.

Communicate financial information clearly to clients who may not have an accounting background.

Provide meaningful commentary and insights rather than simply presenting financial reports.

Identify opportunities to improve client profitability, cash flow, financial controls, and accounting processes.

Proactively communicate issues, deadlines, risks, and opportunities to clients and the internal team.

Work directly with the founder and senior team members on client requirements and complex accounting matters.

Review, Quality Control & Process Improvement



Review accounting work for accuracy, completeness, and compliance.

Identify and correct errors before reports are provided to clients.

Establish and maintain efficient accounting processes and workflows.

Improve internal systems, procedures, and reporting processes.

Assist junior accountants and bookkeepers with technical questions and accounting issues.

Provide guidance, coaching, and quality reviews where required.

Take ownership of deadlines and ensure client deliverables are completed accurately and on time.

About You



We are looking for an accountant who is experienced, commercially minded, detail-oriented, and comfortable taking ownership.



You will ideally have:



5+ years of accounting, bookkeeping, or related experience, with demonstrated experience handling multiple clients.

Strong experience working with Australian businesses and accounting requirements.

Advanced working knowledge of Xero.

Strong understanding of BAS, GST, reconciliations, AP/AR, and month-end accounting.

Experience preparing and analysing financial statements and management reports.

Strong understanding of accounting principles and financial controls.

Excellent attention to detail and ability to identify discrepancies.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

Confidence communicating directly with business owners and senior stakeholders.

Ability to explain financial information clearly and provide practical recommendations.

Strong time-management and organisational skills.

Ability to manage multiple clients, competing priorities, and deadlines independently.

High level of integrity, confidentiality, accountability, and professionalism.

Formal qualifications in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, or a related discipline.

Senior-Level Advantage



Candidates with the following experience will be highly regarded:



Experience managing a portfolio of Australian clients.

Experience in an Australian accounting or public practice firm.

Experience reviewing or supervising the work of junior accountants/bookkeepers.

Experience with payroll accounting and payroll reconciliations.

Experience with fixed assets and depreciation schedules.

Experience preparing cash-flow forecasts and financial analysis.

Experience with budgeting and forecasting.

Experience assisting with year-end financial statements and tax preparation.

Experience improving accounting systems, workflows, and internal controls.

Experience working with multiple entities or complex business structures.

Experience providing financial and commercial insights to business owners.

Key Performance Expectations



Success in this role will be measured by:



Accuracy and completeness of client accounts.

Timely completion of BAS, month-end, and other compliance deadlines.

Quality and reliability of financial reporting.

Effective management of client accounts and relationships.

Reduction of accounting errors and outstanding reconciliations.

Timely resolution of AP/AR issues and discrepancies.

Ability to identify financial trends, risks, and opportunities.

Client satisfaction and retention.

Contribution to process improvements and operational efficiency.

Ability to work independently while maintaining strong communication with the wider team.

What We Offer



Competitive salary: depending on experience and skillset.

Fully remote working environment.

Flexible and autonomous work culture.

Opportunity to manage a diverse portfolio of Australian clients.

Direct exposure to business owners and senior management.

Opportunity to work closely with the founder and experienced accounting professionals.

Supportive and collaborative team environment.

Opportunities for professional development and career progression.

Exposure to a variety of industries and business models.

Opportunity to take on greater responsibility as the firm continues to grow.

Why Join Us?



This is more than a bookkeeping or transaction-processing position.



We are looking for someone who wants to own their client portfolio, understand the businesses behind the numbers, and become a trusted financial partner to our clients.



If you are an experienced accountant who enjoys solving problems, improving processes, analysing financial information, and helping businesses make better decisions, we would love to hear from you.



Apply Now

title: Social Media & Content Strategist — Luxury Aesthetics Brand
description:
Social Media & Content Strategist — Luxury Aesthetics Brand



Prima Doll Aesthetics is a boutique, luxury medical aesthetics practice looking for a creative and strategic Social Media & Content Strategist to help us grow our online presence and create content that feels elevated, educational, authentic, and distinctly Prima Doll.



We are NOT looking for someone to simply post content or follow trends.



We are looking for someone who understands content strategy, storytelling, audience growth, and luxury branding and can help us turn our expertise into content that people actually want to watch, save, share, and follow.



What You’ll Do



* Develop a monthly social media content strategy aligned with our brand and growth goals

* Help identify strong content topics, hooks, and angles for Instagram Reels and other short-form content

* Develop content ideas around aesthetics education, skincare, natural-looking results, patient education, and relatable conversations about aesthetics

* Help organize our content pillars and create a simple monthly content calendar

* Review our existing content and recommend ways to improve engagement, retention, and follower growth

* Identify relevant trends and determine which ones actually fit a sophisticated medical aesthetics brand

* Help turn our ideas and expertise into engaging short-form content

* Provide guidance on what footage/content should be captured

* Edit or coordinate editing of approximately 8–10 short-form videos per month

* Create clean captions/subtitles and simple, polished edits when appropriate

* Maintain a consistent luxury, feminine, sophisticated visual identity

* Provide basic monthly insight into what content is performing well and what we should do more of



The Brand



Prima Doll Aesthetics is intentionally different from a typical medspa.



Our brand is centered around:



* Natural-looking, thoughtful aesthetics

* Education over pressure

* A personalized patient experience

* Luxury without being pretentious

* Evidence-based aesthetic treatments

* Helping women feel confident without feeling like they need to change who they are



Our content should feel smart, warm, relatable, sophisticated, and human.



We are NOT looking for someone who wants to make every video highly trendy, overly edited, or filled with unnecessary effects.



We believe good content should sound like a real person having a conversation—not an advertisement.



Ideal Candidate



You are a great fit if you:



* Have experience developing social media/content strategy

* Understand Instagram Reels and short-form content

* Have a strong understanding of hooks, retention, storytelling, and audience growth

* Have experience with beauty, aesthetics, wellness, healthcare, luxury, or personal brands

* Have excellent visual taste and understand luxury branding

* Can recognize trends without blindly following them

* Are creative but also strategic

* Can take an idea and turn it into a clear, actionable piece of content

* Communicate well and meet deadlines

* Are interested in building a long-term relationship with a growing brand



Medical aesthetics, beauty, skincare, wellness, or luxury brand experience is a strong plus.



Monthly Scope



* Approximately 8–10 short-form videos/content pieces per month

* Monthly content strategy/calendar

* Content ideas and hooks

* Guidance on filming and content creation

* Video editing and/or coordination of editing

* One-two round of reasonable revisions

* Basic monthly performance review and recommendations



This is intended to be a long-term position for the right person, with the opportunity to take on additional responsibilities as the brand grows.



How to Apply



Please send:



1. Your portfolio or examples of brands/accounts you have helped grow

2. Examples of short-form content you have created or strategically developed

3. A brief explanation of your approach to growing a luxury beauty/aesthetics brand on Instagram

4. Your preferred editing/content tools

5. Your availability and typical response time



Applicants without relevant examples of social media strategy and short-form content will not be considered.



Selected applicants may be asked to complete a short paid trial project.

title: VIDEO EDITOR
description:
# Video Editor



We are looking for an experienced Video Editor to join our creative agency, working across a wide range of client projects, including social content, hospitality, events, promotional campaigns and branded video.



This role requires a technically confident and highly organised editor who can work efficiently across multiple projects while maintaining a consistently high standard. You should be comfortable working to quick turnaround times, responding to feedback and adapting edits as client requirements develop.



## Key Responsibilities



* Edit short-form and long-form video content for a variety of clients and platforms.

* Work confidently with Sony S-Log footage and other professional camera formats.

* Colour-correct and match footage from different cameras, lighting conditions and locations.

* Apply considered colour grading where required.

* Build and manage clean, well-structured Premiere Pro projects and sequences.

* Organise multimedia assets, including footage, logos, graphics, photographs, music, audio, sound effects and transitions.

* Follow project briefs, brand guidelines and creative direction.

* Export and deliver content in the correct formats for social media, websites, advertising and other platforms.

* Manage multiple projects and deadlines within a fast-moving agency environment.

* Respond professionally to feedback and complete revision rounds accurately.

* Identify technical or creative issues before final delivery.



## Essential Requirements



* Minimum of two years’ professional video-editing experience.

* Intermediate to advanced knowledge of Adobe Premiere Pro.

* Experience editing and colour-correcting S-Log footage.

* Strong understanding of exposure, white balance, skin tones, colour matching and basic colour theory.

* Ability to create clear, structured and easily transferable Premiere Pro projects.

* Excellent file-management and media-organisation skills.

* Strong attention to detail, particularly around spelling, captions, audio, colour and export settings.

* Very high standard of written and spoken English.

* Ability to understand creative feedback and translate it accurately into the edit.

* Strong communication skills and a professional approach to revisions.

* Comfortable working across different styles, industries and project formats.

* Ability to balance quick turnaround times with attention to detail and high-quality output.

* Reliable access to high-speed internet capable of uploading and downloading project folders of 50GB or more.



## The Ideal Candidate



You are dependable, flexible and comfortable managing several projects at different stages. You understand that agency work can move quickly and that client feedback may require creative changes, new versions or a shift in direction.



You take pride in the technical quality of your work, but you also understand pacing, storytelling, music selection and what makes content engaging. You communicate clearly, meet agreed deadlines and keep your projects organised so another editor can open and understand them easily.



## Application



Please include:



* A short introduction outlining your experience.

* A portfolio or showreel demonstrating a range of editing styles.

* Examples of work involving S-Log footage and colour correction.

* Details of your Premiere Pro experience.

* Your general availability and typical turnaround time.

* Confirmation that your internet connection can reliably handle transfers of 50GB or more.

Instead, your job is to make sure the sales process happens consistently and systematically, until it reaches the point where it makes sense for the founder to become involved.

s and messages.

title: Graphic Artist (Direct-Response & Performance Creative)
description:
Job Title: Graphic Artist (Direct-Response & Performance Creative)



At Strategy North, we build performance-led funnels for high-ticket B2C (requiring lead gen) and e-commerce brands. Behind every campaign we run is a high-volume pipeline of visual assets: static ad concepts, scroll-stopping image variations, carousel designs, and promotional graphics that grab attention in crowded feeds. We're looking for a Graphic Artist who can own that visual output—someone comfortable taking raw concepts, ad angles, and reference files to churn out polished, high-converting ad graphics without needing step-by-step direction.



To be clear, this is not a web-building or funnel-setup role. You won't be building pages in GoHighLevel or touching code. Your job is purely the creative engine: designing and editing performance-driven ad assets so our media buyers have the visual hooks they need to drive results.



Your Role



Design and edit high-converting static ad graphics and graphic overlays for Meta, Google Display, TikTok, and Pinterest.



Leverage AI tools (using our provided Higgsfield account) to generate high-volume design concepts, background variations, and visual assets rapidly.



Take winning ad concepts and produce creative variations (testing background colors, headline treatments, visual hooks, CTAs, and layout tweaks).



Format, resize, and optimize ad assets across multiple aspect ratios (1:1, 9:16, 4:5, 16:9) for various placements.



Retouch, edit, and manipulate product photos, lifestyle images, and raw client assets to make them feed-ready and visually striking.



Develop eye-catching infographics, comparison charts, and visual proof assets for ad creatives and marketing materials.



Keep internal design libraries organized, ensuring raw files, exports, and assets are structured for easy handoffs to media buyers.



What We're Looking For



Portfolio Required: A strong portfolio demonstrating direct-response ad design, social media graphics, and digital marketing assets (applications without a portfolio will not be considered).



Proven Experience: Direct experience working with US or Australian businesses, understanding their market aesthetics and direct-response nuances.



Technical Mastery: High proficiency in Photoshop and Illustrator (Figma or Canva proficiency for quick edits is a strong bonus).



AI Tool Integration: Comfort using AI creative tools (specifically Higgsfield) to generate images, scale asset volume, and speed up design workflows.



Direct-Response Expertise: Deep knowledge of visual hierarchy, thumb-stopping contrast, clear typography, and conversion-focused CTA placement.



Data-Driven Adaptability: Ability to take media buyer feedback, analyze performance metrics, and quickly pivot creative angles based on winning data.



Speed & Precision: Fast worker who thrives on high-volume asset creation while maintaining strict attention to detail, correct specs, and precise file formats.



Niche Experience: Prior work with e-commerce, high-ticket lead gen, or DTC brands is a major plus.



What You Get



Minimum 20 hours per week, with room to grow as our creative testing volume expands.



A 2-week paid trial to start, ensuring a mutual fit.



Access to agency AI accounts (including Higgsfield) to streamline your creative output.



Opportunity to design for growing brands in finance, investing, and DTC across the US and Australian markets.



Be part of a lean, results-driven agency where your visual assets directly scale revenue.



How to Apply

Please submit your resume along with a link to your portfolio showcasing your best direct-response and performance ad designs.
