title: AI Video Editor for DTC Supplement Brand — Direct Response Ads & VSLs
description:
# AI Video Editor for DTC Supplement Brand — Direct Response Ads & VSLs



We’re a fast-growing German DTC supplement brand looking for a **high-level AI Video Editor** who understands one thing above all:



**Your job is not to make videos look pretty. Your job is to make people watch, believe, and buy.**



We’re looking for someone who can take scripts, raw footage, AI-generated assets, UGC, voiceovers, and creative concepts and turn them into **high-converting Direct Response video ads and VSLs**.



Most videos will be approximately **2–5 minutes long**, with some shorter ad variations.



This is a **long-term, full-time position**. We are looking to hire immediately.



## What You’ll Be Editing



You’ll primarily create:



- Direct Response
 / Instagram video ads

- 2–5 minute VSL-style ads

- AI UGC creatives

- AI-generated animations and scenes

- Native-style advertorial videos

- Testimonial / story-based ads

- Educational / authority-style ads

- Hook and angle variations for existing winners

- New iterations based on performance data



Our audience is primarily **45–70+ years old in Germany**, so the editing needs to feel credible, native, easy to understand, and persuasive — not like a flashy TikTok edit made for teenagers.



## What We’re Looking For



You should already understand the fundamentals of **Direct Response advertising**.



That means understanding concepts like:



- Hooks

- Pattern interrupts

- Curiosity

- Retention

- Pacing

- Storytelling

- Problem → agitation → solution

- Mechanism

- Proof

- Authority

- Testimonials

- Objection handling

- Future pacing

- CTAs

- Visual reinforcement of the copy

- Keeping the viewer engaged throughout a 2–5 minute video



You need to understand that **every visual, cut, subtitle, animation, sound effect, B-roll choice, and transition needs a reason to exist.**



We do NOT want someone who simply adds subtitles, stock footage, and transitions to a script.



We want someone who can actually **think like a Direct Response marketer.**



## AI Skills Are Extremely Important



You should be very comfortable using modern AI tools to create better ads faster.



Ideally, you have experience with things like:



- AI UGC

- AI avatars

- AI voiceovers

- AI image generation

- Image-to-video

- AI animation

- AI B-roll generation

- Lip-sync

- Generative video

- AI-assisted editing



Experience with tools such as **Kling, Veo, Runway, HeyGen, ElevenLabs, Midjourney, Nano Banana, ChatGPT, CapCut, Premiere Pro, After Effects** or similar tools is a major plus.



We care less about which exact tools you use and more about the **quality of the final creative**.



## You’re a Strong Fit If…



- You’ve edited Direct Response ads before

- You understand DTC / eCommerce advertising

- You have a strong instinct for what keeps viewers watching

- You understand that retention matters more than fancy editing

- You can turn a script into strong visual storytelling without being micromanaged

- You can generate AI scenes when normal B-roll isn’t good enough

- You know how to make AI UGC feel believable and native

- You can study winning ads and understand WHY they work

- You can create multiple iterations without every video feeling identical

- You’re fast without sacrificing quality

- You take feedback well and improve quickly

- You care about performance, not your editing ego



Experience with **supplements, health products, info products, advertorial funnels, VSLs, or other aggressive Direct Response markets** is a big advantage.



## You’re NOT a Fit If…



- Your main focus is cinematic editing

- You need extremely detailed instructions for every scene

- You’ve never studied Direct Response marketing

- You think good editing means adding more effects

- You rely entirely on generic stock footage

- You don’t actively use AI in your workflow

- You cannot analyze an ad and explain why it works

- You’re looking for a casual freelance side project



## Compensation



**Starting salary: $1,000 USD/month**



If your work is strong and you prove yourself during the first month, we are open to increasing this to approximately:



**$1,200 USD/month after Month 1**



From there, compensation can continue increasing based on:



- Creative quality

- Speed

- Reliability

- Ability to work independently

- Ad performance

- Contribution to the creative team



We are looking for someone we can work with **long term**, not someone to edit three videos and disappear.



## How to Apply



Please send:



1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Your portfolio

3. Examples of your **AI-generated video / AI UGC work**

4. Which AI tools you currently use

5. Your current availability

6. Your timezone

7. Your expected monthly salary



And answer these two questions:



**1. What do you believe separates a high-converting Direct Response video from a normal well-edited video?**



**2. If a 3-minute ad has a major viewer drop-off after the first 15 seconds, what would probably be the main for the drop? 



If your portfolio is mainly cinematic videos, music videos, gaming edits, or short-form entertainment content, this position is probably not the right fit.



We are looking for someone who wants to become **exceptionally good at AI-powered Direct Response creative** and build winning ads with us for the long term.



**If that sounds like you, apply.**

title: Outbound Cold-Calling / Outreach Specialist
description:
About Neugent

Neugent AI LLC is a small AI consulting and engineering shop -- "AI agents that actually work." We build custom chatbots, voice agents, and automation for businesses that know what they want automated but don't have the engineering resources to build it themselves.



The role

We're looking for someone based in the Philippines to run outbound cold-calling for Neugent, full workday, timed to hit prime calling hours across all four continental US time zones (EST, CST, MST, PST) back-to-back.



What you'd actually be doing

- Cold calling prospects across a schedule built to hit EST/CST/MST/PST prime hours in sequence

- Researching good niches to call into using our own prospect-scoring criteria (decision-maker accessibility, budget, urgency, revenue fit, sales cycle speed, competitive saturation, referenceability)

- Writing and refining call scripts that hold up over real calls, not just read well on paper

- Logging call outcomes and prospect status so we can see pipeline movement without having to ask



What we're looking for

- No accent -- needs to sound natural to a US-based prospect picking up a cold call

- Good with words -- comfortable improvising past a script when a call goes off-plan

- Knows how to research good niches, or can be trained fast on our scoring criteria

- Knows how to write good scripts, or learns it quickly by listening to their own call recordings

- Good English, spoken and written

- A voice that carries authority -- prospects need to take the call seriously in the first 10 seconds (use the word "cadence" in your application so we know you read this)



Schedule

Full workday, scheduled to cover EST through PST prime calling windows -- maximum coverage of the US business day.



How we screen

1. Apply with at least 8 Apply Points attached to your application.

2. Short written application

3. A voice sample or short recorded call

4. A real test task: we'll give you a handful of sample prospects and our scoring criteria and ask you to rank them -- this is literally the "research good niches" part of the job, not a hypothetical.



Compensation

$600/month base, full-time. Plus 15-25% commission on profit from any contract your outreach leads to closing -- profit meaning contract value minus direct expenses only (e.g. subcontractor costs), on contracts in the $1,000-$10,000 range. Example: a $5,000 contract with $1,000 in direct costs nets $4,000 profit, meaning $600-$1,000 commission on that deal alone.

title: Executive Assistant | Founder's Right Hand
description:
Remote | Philippines Preffered ???????? | Freelance Contractor | Part-Time 



Hi, I'm Sophie and I am looking for an exceptional Executive Assistant to become my right hand as I move into the next stage of growing my business! 



This isn't a traditional EA role where your entire job will be managing a calendar, organising an inbox and completing admin tasks.



There will be some of that, but what I really need is someone who can help me create space, stay organised and keep specific parts moving without everything having to live in my head.



I work across multiple online businesses supporting them operations and client success, alongside running and growing my own business. Over the next six months, I have some big plans for where I'm taking my business and I'm looking for someone brilliant who can grow alongside me and help me execute them!



I want to get to the point where I can think:

"It's handled."

And not feel the need to check.



What You'll Own

Your role will sit across executive support, business operations, project management and a small amount of personal admin.

The exact responsibilities will evolve because I'm specifically looking for someone who can grow into the role as the business grows.



Executive + Business Support:

You'll help me keep control of the moving pieces across my business, including things like:

Managing my calendar, meetings and commitments

Supporting with inbox and general business administration

Keeping track of deadlines, actions and open loops

Managing and organising projects

Making sure things I've committed to actually happen

Following up on outstanding actions

Preparing documents, resources and information

Researching tools, opportunities, ideas and solutions

Managing client invoicing and associated admin

Organising files, documentation and business information

Supporting communication and coordination across the wider team

Turning meetings, conversations and ideas into clear actions

Creating and maintaining processes and SOPs

Helping me keep Asana and our wider operations clean and organised

Supporting ad-hoc projects as the business evolves



There may also occasionally be personal admin that I need help taking off my plate.. research, appointments, bookings or general life admin - but this isn't primarily a personal assistant role.



This Role Will Evolve:

I don't have a perfectly defined list of everything you'll be doing six months from now.

That's intentional.

I'm entering a period where I want to create significantly more space in my own workload so I can focus on growth, sales and building what's next.



As that happens I want an EA beside me who can help take ideas from:

"We need to do this."

to:

"Here's the plan, here's what's happening, here's what's outstanding and here's what I need from you."



You won't be expected to make major strategic business decisions for me.

But I absolutely want someone who can help turn strategy into organised execution.



???? I Need a Right Hand, Not a Task-Taker

This is probably the most important part of the job description.

Of course I'll give you tasks. Sometimes you'll receive a clearly documented process or asset and your job will simply be to make sure everything within it is actioned properly and filed where it belongs.

Other times, I might send you a Slack message with an idea, something that needs sorting or a problem I need help figuring out.

I need someone who can comfortably handle both.



I'm not looking for someone who finishes their task list and waits to be told what to do next.



I want someone who starts to understand:

What matters.

What's outstanding.

What's coming up.

What needs me.

What doesn't need me.

And what might become a problem if we don't deal with it now.

If you need something from me, chase me.

If I'm becoming the blocker, tell me.

If I've forgotten something, remind me.

If you notice something hasn't been followed through, pick it up.

If there's a better way to organise something, suggest it.



And if something can be solved without unnecessarily bringing it back to me, I'd love you to solve it.



The goal is to reduce the amount of things I have to think about - not create another person I have to manage.



Online Business Experience Is Essential

You must have previous experience directly supporting a founder or senior leader within a startup and/or growing online business.



Experience within service based businesses, online coaching, consulting, agencies or similar environments would be especially valuable.



This matters because I need someone who understands the pace and reality of this world.



Prior exposure to things like offer development, scaling projects, launches, operational builds or periods of rapid growth would be a huge advantage.



You don't need to have done everything.



But you do need to understand the environment you're stepping into.



AI Experience Is a HUGE Advantage

AI is becoming increasingly important to how I work and where my business is going. I'd love to find someone who is already a strong AI user. NOTE: your core role will not be around AI builds, this is more just for you to use AI to your advantage in your everyday work.



That might mean you're comfortable with things like:

ChatGPT and Claude

Deep research and information synthesis

Building effective prompts and reusable AI workflows

Using AI to organise large amounts of information

Turning messy information into structured outputs

Using AI to accelerate research and execution

Exploring new AI tools and identifying useful applications

Finding ways to automate or simplify repetitive work



If you're someone who naturally thinks:

"There must be a smarter/faster way to do this."

...we'll probably work very well together!



But AI should enhance your judgement, not replace it.



I don't want someone who pastes everything into ChatGPT and sends me whatever comes back.



Strong written English, critical thinking and human judgement are essential.



Tech + Systems:

You should be very comfortable with technology and able to learn new platforms quickly.



My current world includes tools such as:

Asana | Slack | Google Workspace | Google Calendar | ChatGPT | Claude | Kajabi | Dubsado



You don't need experience with every platform.



What matters much more is that you're tech confident, resourceful and capable of figuring things out without needing step-by-step instructions for everything.



I'm Looking For Someone Who…

Takes ownership - if something sits with you, I shouldn't need to chase it or check it's been done.

Thinks ahead - you notice what's coming, what's missing and what could become a problem before I point it out.

Works independently - you're resourceful, use your initiative and know when to figure something out vs when you genuinely need my input.

Can turn chaos into action - whether I give you a structured project or drop an idea into Slack, you can work out what needs to happen next and keep it moving.

Understands online business - you've worked closely with a founder in a startup/scaling environment and understand that priorities can move quickly.

Communicates exceptionally well - your English is excellent, you keep me informed without overcommunicating, and you're comfortable chasing me when I'm the blocker.

Is tech + AI savvy - you're naturally curious about better tools, smarter processes and ways we can work more efficiently.



More than anything, I'm looking for someone I can trust completely. I want to give you something, know it's in safe hands and not feel the need to check up on it.



Excellent spoken and written English is imperative.

You'll be working closely with me, sometimes handling information or communications on my behalf, so I need to trust your judgement and communication completely.



What Success Looks Like

A few months into working together, I want there to be significantly less sitting in my head.

I want my projects organised.

My commitments tracked.

My admin handled.

My open loops closed.

My operations running.



And I want to be able to step away from my laptop and know that if something needs attention, you'll either handle it or make sure I know about it.



Ultimately, I want more of my own time and energy going towards the things that actually require me, particularly growth, sales and the next stage of the business.



That's the level of trust I'm looking to build with this person.



Pay + Hours

$10-$15 USD/hour depending on experience

Freelance contractor

Philippines-based

Approximately 20 hours per month initially

Significant room for the role to grow for the right person

Remote

Primarily asynchronous

Some crossover with UK working hours would be beneficial

Long-term opportunity for someone who becomes an integral part of the business



I'm much more interested in finding the right person than simply filling the position quickly.



To Apply

Please send:

1. Tell me about you + your experience

I'd love to know who you are, the businesses you've previously supported and what your role actually looked like day to day.

In particular, tell me about your experience working directly with founders in startup, scaling or growing online businesses.

Please include any experience you've had supporting:

Business growth | Project management | Offer development | Operations | Scaling | Executive support



2. Send me a short Loom video

Please record a short Loom with your camera on introducing yourself.

Tell me:

A little about you

The kind of founder/business you've previously supported

What you actually owned in that role

Why you think you'd be a great fit for this position



Please don't read me a perfectly polished AI-generated application.



I want to meet you.



I'm looking for someone smart, capable and genuinely dependable who wants to become a key part of what I'm building over the next few years.



If you're the person who naturally brings order to chaos, remembers what everyone else forgets and loves being the person behind the scenes who makes sure things actually happen, I'd love to hear from you.

title: Customer Review Specialist (Outbound Calls)
description:
Please fill out the form:



About Goda



We are Goda, a fast-growing DTC brand in the fragrance and skincare space, selling across the US and globally. Our hero products have built a loyal customer base, and we're scaling fast.



We run paid social at high volume, bringing in new customers every day. Our Customer Success team plays a critical role in turning first-time buyers into long-term customers by proactively reaching out, building trust, addressing concerns, and creating positive customer experiences that drive retention.



This is not a traditional customer support role. We don't wait for customers to contact us — we proactively reach out to ensure they succeed with our products and remain engaged with our brand.



The Role



You'll be responsible for making outbound calls to customers across the US market. Your primary goal is to strengthen customer relationships, improve retention, reduce subscription churn, gather feedback, and ensure customers are getting the most value from their experience with Goda.



You'll work closely with our Customer Success and Operations teams, follow established workflows, and maintain detailed records of customer interactions within our systems.



You'll report directly to the Customer Success Manager and be measured against activity, quality, and retention-focused KPIs. We expect you to take ownership, identify customer trends, and surface opportunities that help improve both the customer experience and business performance.



What You'll Be Doing

Outbound Customer Engagement

• Making outbound calls to customers throughout the day to provide support, answer questions, and strengthen customer relationships

• Conducting proactive follow-ups with new customers to ensure a positive experience with their purchase

• Reaching out to subscription customers regarding upcoming renewals, account concerns, and retention opportunities

• Handling customer objections professionally and helping customers find solutions that fit their needs

• Gathering customer feedback and identifying recurring themes, concerns, or opportunities

• Maintaining accurate records of customer interactions, outcomes, and follow-up actions

• Building rapport with customers while representing the brand in a professional and customer-centric manner



Retention & Customer Success

• Identifying customers at risk of cancellation and proactively addressing concerns

• Supporting customer retention initiatives through personalized conversations and relationship-building

• Helping customers understand product benefits, subscription options, and available solutions

• Escalating complex customer concerns through the appropriate internal channels when necessary

• Working closely with leadership to surface customer insights that may improve retention and customer experience



Quality & Accountability

• Meeting daily outbound call targets and productivity expectations

• Maintaining high-quality conversations and customer satisfaction standards

• Following established processes while applying sound judgment when handling unique situations

• Contributing ideas that improve customer experience, call workflows, and team processes

• Taking ownership of customer outcomes rather than simply completing activities



What We're Looking For

Must-Haves

• Prior outbound calling experience in a call center, sales, customer success, retention, or similar phone-based environment

• Comfortable handling high call volumes (40–50 outbound calls per day)

• Excellent spoken English with a neutral or American-accented communication style

• Strong verbal communication skills and the ability to build rapport quickly over the phone

• Resilient, confident, and comfortable handling objections, rejection, and difficult conversations

• Highly organized with strong attention to detail when documenting customer interactions

• Proactive mindset — you identify opportunities and problems before they become larger issues



Nice to Have

• Experience working with subscription-based DTC or e-commerce brands

• Experience with retention, customer success, or subscription management

• Familiarity with CRM, dialer, or customer communication platforms

• Experience supporting US-based customers



Instant No's

• Discomfort with high-volume outbound calling

• Poor verbal communication or difficulty building rapport over the phone

• Lack of ownership when customer issues arise

• Failure to document customer interactions accurately

• Inability to handle rejection or maintain professionalism during challenging conversations

• Waiting to be told what to do instead of proactively taking action



How We Measure Your Performance

• Daily outbound call activity and productivity metrics

• Customer retention and subscription save performance

• Quality assurance scores and call reviews

• Customer satisfaction and feedback

• Accuracy of customer records and follow-up completion

• Consistency in meeting team KPIs and operational standards



Compensation & Benefits

• Competitive salary based on experience

• Fully remote position

• Opportunity to work with a fast-growing DTC brand serving customers across the US

• Clear career growth opportunities within Customer Success and Retention

• Structured training, SOPs, and support systems



???? Our customers are at the center of everything we do. If you're confident on the phone, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and enjoy helping customers succeed while building long-term relationships, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Founding Full-Stack Developer — Contract / V1 Build
description:
Founding Full-Stack Developer — Contract / V1 Build



I'm building Scout — Your AI Private Investigator, a consumer web product that helps users investigate and verify information about someone they're dating or getting to know.



I'm looking for a strong, product-minded full-stack developer to help build the first working version.



This is not a basic ChatGPT wrapper.



Scout will take information supplied by a user, conduct structured research using available APIs and lawful public-source data, organize and analyze the findings, compare evidence against claims made by the subject, and produce a polished investigative Case Report.



What V1 Needs to Do



The initial product will include:



Marketing/landing site



User signup and authentication



Payment/checkout



New Case intake form



Ability to enter identifiers such as name, location, phone,
, social handles, employer, photos and other known information



Freeform field where users can provide claims or context they want Scout to investigate



Integrations with appropriate third-party APIs/data sources



AI-assisted extraction, matching, analysis and synthesis



Source/evidence preservation



Investigation processing/status experience



Structured Case Report generation



Saved case history



Basic admin functionality



Production deployment



The Core Product



The most important output is the Scout Case Report.



Reports should synthesize findings into sections such as:



TL;DR



Identity summary



What checks out



Potential inconsistencies



Digital footprint



Relevant timeline



Image/profile findings where technically feasible



Information Scout could not verify



Investigative summary



Sources/evidence



The experience should feel like opening a modern private-investigation case file — not receiving a generic AI-generated wall of text.



Important Product Principles



Scout must distinguish between:



Verified information



Information that appears consistent



Potential inconsistencies



Uncertain matches



Information that could not be verified



The platform should avoid presenting AI inference as fact.



The architecture should also be modular so additional data sources and investigative capabilities can be added over time.



What I'm Looking For



Ideally, you have experience with:



Building full-stack SaaS or consumer web applications



React / Next.js or similar modern frontend frameworks



Backend/database architecture



Authentication



Stripe or similar payments



Third-party API integrations



AI/LLM integrations



Structured AI outputs



File/image uploads



Report/dashboard interfaces



Cloud deployment



Security and privacy best practices



Experience working with investigative, identity, OSINT, search, enrichment or data-aggregation products is a major plus.



You Should Be



Product-minded, not just waiting for tickets



Comfortable helping evaluate technical approaches



Able to communicate tradeoffs clearly



Willing to push back when something is unnecessarily complex



Strong at shipping practical V1 products



Comfortable working directly with a founder



Project Structure



This will begin as a contract V1 build.



I expect to break development into milestones rather than committing the entire build upfront.



There may be significant ongoing work after V1 for the right person.



When Applying



Please include:



A brief introduction.



Links to 2–3 relevant products you've built.



Which parts of those products you personally developed.



Your experience integrating third-party APIs.



Your experience working with AI/LLMs.



Your preferred technology stack for a product like this and why.



How you would generally approach building Scout's investigation workflow.



Your availability.



Your hourly rate and/or preferred project pricing structure.



Please also start your application with the words SCOUT CASE FILE so I know you read the full posting.



I'm especially interested in developers who can think like an early-stage product builder rather than simply execute specifications.

title: Head of Growth Operations
description:
The Role 

ProfitGrid is seeking a Head of Growth Operations to build and operate the commercial system 

that converts our reputation, content, referral relationships, events, and outbound activity into 

qualified opportunities and signed client engagements. 



This is not a traditional brand-marketing position. It is not primarily a content-creation role, and it 

is not a sales-closing role. 



The Head of Growth Operations will own the infrastructure, processes, team, data, and 

execution required to manage the complete commercial funnel: 

Audience ? Captured Lead ? Qualified Opportunity ? Meeting ? Signed Engagement 

? Revenue 

The successful candidate will establish commercial discipline through HubSpot, build 

measurable acquisition and nurturing programs, operationalize content distribution, and create 

repeatable go-to-market playbooks for priority industry verticals. 



This role will initially report directly to the CEO. As ProfitGrid's growth organization develops, the 

Head of Growth Operations is expected to become a key operating leader within the broader 

growth function.



Required Experience 

Candidates should have: 



? Significant relevant experience in B2B growth, demand generation, revenue operations, 

lifecycle marketing, or marketing operations. 

? Demonstrated experience managing a complete B2B commercial funnel. 

? Deep, hands-on HubSpot experience, including pipeline configuration, automation, 

reporting, attribution, and data governance. 

? Experience marketing or selling to US-based executives, founders, business owners, or 

other senior decision-makers. 

? Experience with high-value offerings and extended sales cycles. 

? Experience managing multidisciplinary teams. 

? Strong analytical and reporting capabilities. 

? Excellent written and spoken English. 

? Strong project-management and operating discipline. 

? The confidence to enforce commercial processes with senior colleagues. 

? A record of producing measurable qualified pipeline—not merely awareness or raw lead 

volume. 

? Experience managing agencies, contractors, vendors, or distributed teams. 

? The ability to work effectively in a fast-growing, entrepreneurial environment with 

evolving processes. 



Principal Responsibilities 



Commercial Funnel Management 

? Define and document each stage of ProfitGrid's commercial funnel. 

? Establish objective entry and exit criteria for each stage. 

? Create a common definition of a qualified opportunity. 

? Ensure every lead has a source, status, owner, next action, and follow-up date. 

? Establish service standards for lead response, qualification, routing, and follow-up. 

? Monitor progression from initial inquiry through signed engagement and realized 

revenue. 

? Identify funnel leakage and implement corrective action. 

? Conduct regular pipeline audits to identify stale, duplicated, misclassified, or 

unsupported opportunities. 

? Distinguish active opportunities from long-term prospects, dormant relationships, and 

disqualified leads. 



HubSpot and Revenue Operations 

? Serve as the business owner of HubSpot for growth and business development. 

? Design pipeline stages, properties, workflows, automation, lead scoring, routing, and 

reporting. 

? Manage the migration, organization, and cleanup of historical prospect and pipeline 

data. 

? Establish controls that support high data completeness and accuracy. 

? Build management dashboards covering: 

? Lead volume and sources 

? Qualified opportunities 

? Meetings 

? Funnel conversion 

? Speed to lead 

? Signed engagements 

? Pipeline value 

? Expected timing 

? Channel attribution 

? Ensure HubSpot supports management decisions rather than functioning as a passive 

contact database. 

? Train relevant team members and enforce CRM operating standards. 

? Coordinate HubSpot adoption across growth, media, business development, and 

transaction teams. 



Content Conversion and Distribution 

? Build the operating system that turns executive thought leadership into consistent, 

multi-channel publishing. 

? Coordinate with ProfitGrid's Media & Production Team on content planning, production, 

editing, repurposing, distribution, and measurement. 

? Ensure relevant articles, videos, podcasts, events, and research products contain 

appropriate and trackable calls to action. 

? Build capture mechanisms for viewers and readers who are not ready for an immediate 

transaction conversation. 

? Develop nurturing programs based on industry, business profile, readiness, and 

demonstrated interests. 

? Track content-assisted opportunities and client engagements. 

? Evaluate content based on commercial outcomes—not solely views, subscribers, 

impressions, or engagement rates. 

? Maintain a content-distribution calendar aligned with ProfitGrid's commercial priorities. 



Vertical Go-to-Market Playbooks 

Develop differentiated go-to-market playbooks for ProfitGrid's priority industry verticals. 

Each playbook should address: 

? Ideal client profile 

? Market segmentation 

? Priority owner personas 

? Qualification criteria 

? Owner pain points and transaction triggers 

? ProfitGrid's value proposition 

? Relevant proof points and case studies 

? Buyer and investor universe 

? Referral-partner ecosystem 

? Content themes 

? Events and industry associations 

? Outbound targets and messaging 

? Lead-nurturing journey 

? Funnel targets and economics 



The Head of Growth Operations will work with senior leadership and subject-matter experts to 

refine strategy while owning implementation, coordination, and measurement. 



Lifecycle Marketing and Database Activation 

? Segment ProfitGrid's database by industry, business profile, readiness, relationship, and 

engagement. 

? Design appropriate journeys for near-term prospects, long-term prospects, referral 

partners, buyers, and dormant relationships. 

? Build systematic
 and other lifecycle-marketing programs. 

? Establish disciplined reactivation campaigns for credible dormant prospects. 

? Ensure campaigns reflect the discretion and professionalism required in middle-market 

M&A. 

? Measure progression from engagement to qualified opportunity and commercial 

outcome. 



Referral, Partnership, Event, and Outbound Operations 

? Build and maintain databases of referral partners, buyers, industry associations, and 

priority business owners. 

? Operationalize referral-partner development programs. 

? Coordinate conferences, proprietary events, webinars, dinners, and other 

relationship-building initiatives. 

? Create pre-event and post-event workflows that convert participation into measurable 

pipeline. 

? Build a disciplined outbound capability aimed at carefully selected business owners and 

referral partners. 

? Test channels and messaging systematically. 

? Stop programs that do not demonstrate credible commercial potential. 

? Maintain attribution across referral, event, content, outbound, organic, and paid 

channels. 



Growth Team Leadership 

? Assess the capabilities and capacity of the people supporting growth. 

? Recommend the organizational structure required to meet ProfitGrid's objectives. 

? Hire, onboard, manage, and develop growth-operations personnel as authorized. 

? Establish clear roles, goals, operating procedures, and performance standards. 

? Coordinate effectively with Media & Production without creating confused or overlapping 

ownership. 

? Manage agencies, contractors, technology vendors, and data providers when 

appropriate. 

? Hold internal and external contributors accountable for deadlines and commercial 

outcomes. 



Analytics, Experimentation, and Budget Discipline 

? Establish a disciplined test-and-learn process for growth programs. 

? Define the hypothesis, target audience, investment, expected outcome, and evaluation 

period before launching material experiments. 

? Measure performance across the full commercial funnel. 

? Recommend where ProfitGrid should increase, maintain, reduce, or terminate spending. 

? Maintain appropriate leading indicators while recognizing the firm’s extended sales cycle. 

? Avoid false precision when realized revenue attribution requires time. 

? Prepare clear budget and resource recommendations for senior leadership. 



Management Cadence 

? Lead a regular growth and funnel review with relevant stakeholders. 

? Produce a concise management dashboard identifying: 

? Results versus target 

? Funnel movement 

? New qualified opportunities 

? Conversion issues 

? Stale opportunities 

? Campaign performance 

? Decisions required 

? Accountable owners and deadlines 

? Participate in leadership planning where growth operations are relevant. 

? Work closely with the Chief of Staff while maintaining clear functional ownership. 

? Escalate material risks and missed commitments promptly.
